premise: Ladybug, Snail and Pinecone want to see the far meadow but it is too far for tiny legs; Deer kneels down, carries them on his back, and walks so smoothly nobody slips.
inspiration: The Lion and the Mouse (Aesop), turned: the biggest helps the smallest for no reward but company, and the ride is the adventure.
lesson: Being big is a chance to carry someone.

en-US.title: Deer Gives a Ride
en-US.text: Past the stream was the sunny meadow. Ladybug wanted to see it. Snail wanted to see it. Pinecone wanted to see it. But Ladybug's wings were tiny, and Snail was slow, and Pinecone could only roll downhill. {ladybug:wobble} {snail:wobble} {pinecone:wobble} Too far, they sighed. Deer heard. He came over, tall as a tree, He {deer:pulse 0.4} knelt down. All aboard, said Deer. Ladybug {ladybug:hop} climbed on. Snail {snail:pulse} slid on. Mouse gave Pinecone a push and {pinecone:hop} up she rolled. Hold tight. Deer stood up, slow, slow, slow. Then Deer walked. Not a bump. Not a wobble. Smooth as a cloud. Over the stream. Through the ferns. Into the sun. {ladybug:sparkle} {snail:sparkle} {pinecone:sparkle} The meadow! they cried. Deer knelt again, and down they climbed, and sat in the warm grass. Thank you, said Snail. Any time, said Deer. Company is nice up there.

es-ES.title: Ciervo lleva a sus amigos
es-ES.text: Lejos, pasado el arroyo, estaba el prado soleado. Mariquita quería verlo. Caracol quería verlo. Piña quería verlo. Pero las alas de Mariquita eran diminutas, Caracol era lento y Piña solo sabía rodar cuesta abajo. {ladybug:wobble} {snail:wobble} {pinecone:wobble} Demasiado lejos, suspiraron. Ciervo los oyó. Se acercó, alto como un árbol, {deer:pulse 0.4} Se arrodilló. Todos a bordo, dijo Ciervo. Mariquita {ladybug:hop} subió. Caracol {snail:pulse} se deslizó arriba. Ratón empujó a Piña y {pinecone:hop} arriba rodó. Agarraos fuerte. Ciervo se levantó, despacio, despacio, despacio. Y Ciervo caminó. Ni un bote. Ni un tambaleo. Suave como una nube. Sobre el arroyo. Entre los helechos. Hasta el sol. {ladybug:sparkle} {snail:sparkle} {pinecone:sparkle} ¡El prado!, gritaron. Ciervo se arrodilló otra vez, bajaron y se sentaron en la hierba caliente. Gracias, dijo Caracol. Cuando queráis, dijo Ciervo. Se está bien acompañado ahí arriba.
